name: SoftmaxFlashV2
note: FlashAttention-2 online softmax (first block, isUpdate=false): max=rowmax(x), y=exp(x-max) (un-normalized), sum=rowsum(y). Device-side SoftMaxFlashV2TilingFunc builds the tiling inside the kernel. x=0 -> dst all 1.0, per-row sum=64, max=0. Reduce outputs use AscendC block layout (value in col 0 of each 8-float block).
